```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
```

# 2. Load and filter to China
```{r load-filter}
load("project/data/D003924_Diabetes_Mellitus,_T/genus/D003924_phyloseq_updated_genus.RData")
ps <- subset_samples(pylsq, Project.ID == "PRJNA422434")
rm(pylsq)

ps
table(sample_data(ps)$Disease.MESH.ID)
```

```{r alpha-prep}
alpha <- estimate_richness(ps, measures = c("Shannon")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id")

meta <- sample_data(ps) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id")

alpha_div <- inner_join(alpha, meta, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(Disease = ifelse(Disease.MESH.ID == "D003924", "T2D", "Healthy"))
```

# 3. Metadata / covariate balance between disease groups

```{r meta-sex}
table(alpha_div$Disease, alpha_div$Sex)
chisq.test(table(alpha_div$Disease, alpha_div$Sex))
```
```{r meta-antibiotics}
table(alpha_div$Disease, alpha_div$Recent.antibiotics.use, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r meta-age}
alpha_div %>%
  mutate(Host.age = as.numeric(Host.age)) %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarise(median_age = median(Host.age, na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR_age    = IQR(Host.age, na.rm = TRUE),
            n          = dplyr::n(),
            .groups = "drop")

wilcox.test(as.numeric(Host.age) ~ Disease.MESH.ID, data = alpha_div)
```

```{r meta-age-plot, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
alpha_div %>%
  mutate(Host.age = as.numeric(Host.age)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Disease, Host.age, fill = Disease)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Healthy" = "#56B4E9", "T2D" = "#E74C3C")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Host age", title = "Age by disease (Chinese cohort)")
```

Now BMI. It is missing for most samples, so this is only on the complete cases.
```{r meta-bmi}
alpha_div %>%
  mutate(BMI = as.numeric(BMI)) %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarise(median_BMI = median(BMI, na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR_BMI    = IQR(BMI, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_with_BMI = sum(!is.na(BMI)),
            n          = dplyr::n(),
            .groups = "drop")

wilcox.test(as.numeric(BMI) ~ Disease.MESH.ID, data = alpha_div)
```

```{r depth-by-group}
wilcox.test(Nr..reads.sequenced ~ Disease.MESH.ID, data = alpha_div)

alpha_div %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarise(median_reads = median(Nr..reads.sequenced),
            IQR_reads    = IQR(Nr..reads.sequenced),
            n            = dplyr::n(),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r depth-vs-shannon, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
cor.test(alpha_div$Nr..reads.sequenced, alpha_div$Shannon, method = "spearman")

ggplot(alpha_div, aes(x = Nr..reads.sequenced, y = Shannon, color = Disease)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Healthy" = "#56B4E9", "T2D" = "#E74C3C")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Reads sequenced (log10)", y = "Shannon",
       title = "Sequencing depth vs Shannon diversity (Chinese cohort)")
```

# 5. Alpha diversity by disease

```{r alpha-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Shannon), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Disease, y = value, fill = Disease)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Healthy" = "#56B4E9", "T2D" = "#E74C3C")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Alpha diversity",
         title = "Alpha diversity by disease (Chinese cohort, genus level)")
```

```{r alpha-test}
wilcox.test(Shannon ~ Disease.MESH.ID, data = alpha_div)

alpha_div %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarise(median_Shannon = median(Shannon),
            .groups = "drop")
```

# 6. Beta diversity by disease

```{r beta-dist}
ps_rel    <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))
bray_dist <- distance(ps_rel, method = "bray")
ord_bray  <- ordinate(ps_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = bray_dist)
sample_df <- sample_data(ps_rel) %>% data.frame()
```


```{r pcoa-disease, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
plot_ordination(ps_rel, ord_bray, color = "Disease.MESH.ID") +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("D006262" = "#56B4E9", "D003924" = "#E74C3C"),
                     labels = c("D006262" = "Healthy", "D003924" = "T2D"),
                     name   = "Disease") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Bray–Curtis PCoA - disease (Chinese cohort)")
```

```{r permanova}
adonis2(bray_dist ~ Disease.MESH.ID, data = sample_df, permutations = 999)
```


```{r betadisper}
disp_disease <- betadisper(bray_dist, sample_df$Disease.MESH.ID)
anova(disp_disease)
```

```{r betadisper-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
plot(disp_disease, main = "Dispersion by disease")
```
